## Added

- **Grilling asks only the questions that change the plan.** Every `readyset_ask` question must now
  name the plan decision it changes and how the plan differs per answer. A question whose answers
  all lead to the same plan isn't a question — it's an assumption, recorded under a new `## Assumed`
  section of the brainstorm so it's reviewable rather than silently held. Grilling also stops as
  soon as no open decisions remain, even in round one.

- **A clarity score on the brainstorm, and a lane that follows it.** Grilling writes `clarity`
  (`clear` = 0 open decisions after fact-finding, `partial` = 1–2, `ambiguous` = 3+), plus
  `openDecisions`, `questionsAsked`, and — only when it applies — a `riskFlag`
  (`cross-cutting|migration|api-change|security`). Code maps that to a recommended lane: `clear` →
  fast, `ambiguous` → full, `partial` → fast unless a risk flag escalates it. Set
  `readyset.lane.default: ask | auto | fast | full` (default `ask`) to keep asking, accept the
  recommendation automatically, or force a lane; `--lane` still wins for one run.

- **Every run now records its effective lane and phase boundaries.** `--fast` only filters the
  picker — `--lane fast|full` is what forces the lane — so a run's lane was invisible afterward.
  Each phase boundary (Grill, Explore, Propose, Refine, gate, Apply, Review, Archive) is written to
  the change's `CONTEXT.md` as a machine-parseable event carrying the phase, `start`/`end`, a
  timestamp, the effective lane and its source, and where relevant the phase model and an outcome.

- **A wrong scope contract is repaired once, automatically, before the gate.** A file path in
  `proposal.md`'s `## Files This Change Will Touch` that doesn't exist and isn't marked `(new)` is
  flagged, and after Propose (and after every Refine) Readyset fires at most one turn that rewrites
  just that section and re-checks. The check also catches `(new)` on a file that already exists and
  `(delete)` on a file that doesn't. Remaining problems still only warn.

- **Per-artifact character budgets.** `readyset.artifacts.budget.<proposal|design|specs|tasks>` in
  `~/.omp/agent/config.yml` overrides a lane's default (full: proposal 4,000 / design 5,000 / specs
  6,000 total / tasks 4,000; fast: proposal 4,000 / tasks 3,000). The Propose prompt states them, the
  gate panel shows an `artifacts: N chars (budget M)` line per artifact, and an overrun only warns —
  except a file past **1.5×** its budget, which fires at most one planning-only Trim turn.

- **`--compact auto|always|never` and `readyset.compact.minContextPercent`.** A phase-boundary
  compaction now runs only when the reported context usage is at or above the threshold (default
  25%), so a fresh session skips it; `--compact always` restores the old unconditional behavior and
  `--compact never` suppresses every boundary.

## Changed

- **The fast lane writes a genuinely smaller plan.** It now writes `proposal.md` and `tasks.md`
  only — **no `design.md` and no spec delta**. The acceptance scenarios a spec delta would carry
  live under a `## Acceptance` section in `proposal.md` instead, one `- **WHEN** … **THEN** …` bullet
  each with an `[S1]`, `[S2]`, … id that `tasks.md` references. The lane is recorded as a `lane:`
  line in `proposal.md`'s frontmatter, so `validateChange`, `archiveChange`, the review overlay, and
  the standalone `readyset-flow validate` CLI all agree with no run context. The fast lane also gets
  a smaller `tasks.md` budget (3,000 chars).

- **Apply is pushed toward a minimal diff, and held to the contract.** Apply now gets explicit
  scope-discipline rules, and a file it changes outside the contract with no justification is
  reconciled **once** after Execute — reverted, or recorded under `## Scope deviations` in
  `tasks.md` for the code-review turn to judge. Whatever remains still only warns.

- **Prep phases compact at their own boundaries.** Compaction also fires after grilling, before
  Explore, and after Explore, before Propose — not only before Execute. Everything each phase needs
  is already on disk, so this is **expected** to cut prep-phase token cost (pending the next
  benchmark); each boundary records a `compact` event so the effect is measurable.

## Fixed

- **Turns are reserved for Apply and Review.** Contract repair fires only while 2 turns remain and
  scope reconciliation only while 1 does — a nearly-spent run no longer burns its last turn and
  ends with no `REVIEW.md`.
- **False `NEW-BUT-EXISTS` / `DELETE-BUT-MISSING` after Apply** are gone: once Apply has run, the
  contract is read with post-Apply semantics and the repair turn never fires.
- **Every gate start has a matching end** (a keep-context approval records its skipped compact
  boundary plus the gate end).
- **Diff stats see staged changes** — a fully staged Apply now counts.
- **Directory contract entries resolve** instead of being reported as missing.
- **Scope contracts no longer drop non-JS paths** — `app/handler.go`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`,
  and `Makefile` are accepted now.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install
needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/0.13.0...0.14.0
